_comment: The six families docs/MESSAGE-ENGINE.md 4.2 forbids a message from being about, as regexes over
text and altText. Append-only: an entry is removed only with the argument written
into the pull request, because the reason a rail exists is not visible from the line
Each pattern carries a rationale rather than sitting in a bare list, so a contributor
who trips one is told which rail they hit and can argue with the rail instead of

families.rationale: Never about body weight. A break app that comments on what somebody eats is the category of app people uninstall.
Never about how somebody looks. The app can see a window title. It cannot see a face and must never write as though it can.
docs/MESSAGE-ENGINE.md 4.2: no medical claims, at all. The app says 'your posture', never 'your health'. It is not a health product and has no business behaving like one.
Never about mental health. A joke that borrows the vocabulary of distress is still pointing that vocabulary at the reader, and the reader may be having the week the rubric's bad-day test asks about.
The joke is never 'you are bad at this'. Behaviour is fair game; ability is not.
Never about job security. A bare 'fired' is allowed because an event fires; the patterns here are the ones that can only be about a person losing work.
